slots.label: Heading 1
slots.default: How a move to the cloud actually runs

slots.label: Paragraph 1
slots.default: Migrations are quiet when the decisions are made early. This is the sequence we follow on every move.

slots.label: Paragraph 2
slots.default: We audit what you have, agree what moves, what gets retired and what the new setup should look like.

slots.label: Paragraph 3
slots.default: Licences, identity and security baselines are set up first, so nothing lands in an unprotected tenancy.

slots.label: Paragraph 4
slots.default: Mail, files and apps move in scheduled waves around your working week, with a rollback plan at every stage.

slots.label: Paragraph 5
slots.default: The same service desk that ran the migration supports it afterwards, so nothing gets handed to a stranger.
